objective: verify one auditable model-turn interruption without force-killing the process tree
interrupt_boundary: wait for matching turn/started, then send exactly one turn/interrupt immediately
success_condition: interrupt acknowledgment, matching turn/completed status interrupted, no answer eligibility, and retained per-turn usage or explicit null
race_disposition: if turn completes before interrupt, retain as completion race and do not retry this allocation
failure_disposition: retain exact protocol failure and diagnose before a differently versioned allocation
scope: single no-tool Luna turn; interruption mechanics only; no token-savings, session-continuity, planner-quality or DOOM claim
